items.t: CCJ's Share of Uranium Output Down 20% in Q3: Will 2026 Targets be Met?
items.sum: Cameco cuts its 2026 uranium production outlook after a prolonged Key Lake shutdown, as lower output, falling shares and reduced earnings estimates weigh on prospects.

items.t: Cameco: Underwhelming Q3 Earnings, But Patient Investors Can Gain
items.sum: Cameco's planned outages explain Q3 revenue softness, and shares could return 3.5-4x by 2030 as sector momentum returns. See more on CCJ's bull case here.

items.t: Brokers Suggest Investing in Cameco (CCJ): Read This Before Placing a Bet
items.sum: According to the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), one should invest in Cameco (CCJ). It is debatable whether this highly sought-after metric is effective because Wall Street analysts' recommendations tend to be overly optimistic. Would it be worth investing in the stock?

items.t: Are Options Traders Betting on a Big Move in Cameco Stock?
items.sum: Investors need to pay close attention to CCJ stock based on the movements in the options market lately.

items.t: Uranium Stocks Are Beaten Down, but Earnings Are Starting to Diverge
items.sum: Uranium stocks stay out of favor despite isolated earnings progress; weak momentum keeps value-trap risk alive as investors await sector stabilization.

items.t: BLAST RESOURCES ANNOUNCES APPOINTMENT OF ANDY YACKULIC AS CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
items.sum: Blast Resources Inc. ("Blast" or the "Company") (CSE: BLST) (FRA: O0E) (OTCQB: BLSRF) is pleased to announce the appointment of Andy Yackulic, P. Geo., as the President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective immediately. Mr. Yackulic will succeed James Casey Forward, who will remain with the Company as Chief Financial Officer.
